business_problem: PHOENIX group faced the complexity of a pan-European pharmaceutical distribution network, where manual transport-invoice checks, repetitive customer-service work, fragmented data and uneven digital maturity made it difficult to scale innovation consistently or improve operational efficiency across markets.
solution_summary: BCG helped PHOENIX group move from isolated experiments to an enterprise AI delivery model by creating the GenAI Factory, a structured operating system for choosing, building and scaling high-return use cases. The model links ideation, validation, MVP delivery and scale-up through cross-functional teams, ensuring only use cases with near-term business value move forward. The first wave combined multiple AI services on one backbone: an AI-Powered Inventory Cockpit for real-time visibility and forecasting, a Transport Invoice Validator for automated logistics-cost review, an AI Customer Service Agent for repetitive inquiries and a GenAI RFQ Machine for procurement automation. Built on existing data and cloud platforms, these products were designed as scalable digital services rather than one-off pilots. The resulting architecture ties forecasting, service automation, invoice validation and procurement into a single AI factory model that PHOENIX group can expand across Europe.

solution_components.name: GenAI Factory
solution_components.role: Provides the operating model that prioritizes, validates and scales AI use cases across the business.

solution_components.name: AI-Powered Inventory Cockpit
solution_components.role: Gives country teams real-time inventory visibility and forecasting to optimize working capital.

solution_components.name: Transport Invoice Validator
solution_components.role: Automates validation of logistics costs and helps uncover savings opportunities.

solution_components.name: AI Customer Service Agent
solution_components.role: Handles high-frequency customer queries so human agents can focus on complex cases.

data_flow: Operational data from inventory, logistics, customer-service and procurement processes feeds GenAI Factory use cases. Forecasting outputs surface in the Inventory Cockpit, logistics data is validated by the Invoice Validator, repetitive inquiries are handled through the AI Customer Service Agent, and procurement data drives automated RFQ workflows.
business_outcome: PHOENIX group embedded a repeatable AI delivery model into its digital transformation agenda, giving the company faster forecasting, lower manual processing effort, better service responsiveness and a scalable path for rolling proven AI products across Europe.
architecture_clues: The GenAI Factory governs the lifecycle from ideation through scale rather than just model deployment.
The first wave spans forecasting, customer service, invoice validation and procurement instead of a single function.
The Inventory Cockpit is built on existing data and cloud platforms.
Wave 1 solutions are already being rolled out across multiple European markets.
